# Vlyt

> Mobile business app for South African solo operators: quotes with VAT in ZAR, catalog, stock, expenses and cashflow.

Site: https://vlyt.app/
Blog: https://vlyt.app/blog/

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://vlyt.app/): Product overview
- [Blog index](https://vlyt.app/blog/): All guides
- [SA micro-business quoting checklist](https://vlyt.app/resources/sa-quoting-checklist/)

## Guides

- [Best quoting apps for South African small business (2026)](https://vlyt.app/blog/best-quoting-apps-south-africa-2026/): 2026 comparison of SA quoting approaches and named WhatsApp-first tools (Zakr, QuickQuotes, TradiQuote, QuoteDirect, FieldCard, Vlyt). Criteria: ZAR, VAT, WhatsApp, stock, phone.
- [Cashflow basics for electricians, plumbers and landscapers](https://vlyt.app/blog/cashflow-basics-trades-sa/): A simple cashflow picture for SA trades: income, expenses and money still awaiting payment — without a desktop finance team.
- [How to write a professional quote in South Africa](https://vlyt.app/blog/how-to-write-professional-quote-south-africa/): A practical SA quote template: line items, ZAR, VAT clarity, validity dates, and how to stop reinventing prices in WhatsApp.
- [Product catalog for quote-based businesses](https://vlyt.app/blog/product-catalog-quote-businesses/): How to structure a product catalog so every SA quote reuses real prices — variations, packaging and stock on each item.
- [Quote vs invoice in South Africa: when you need which](https://vlyt.app/blog/quote-vs-invoice-south-africa/): Clear difference between a quote and an invoice for SA small businesses — language, timing, VAT, and what to send on WhatsApp.
- [Run your SA business from your phone: quotes, stock and cashflow](https://vlyt.app/blog/run-sa-business-from-phone/): How South African solo operators keep catalog, quotes, stock and cashflow together on a phone — without a desktop office stack.
- [How to send a quote on WhatsApp without losing the numbers](https://vlyt.app/blog/send-quote-whatsapp-without-losing-numbers/): A SA-friendly workflow: build the quote in a catalog tool, share on WhatsApp, and keep the source of truth out of the chat thread.
- [Why spreadsheet quoting breaks down (and what to use instead)](https://vlyt.app/blog/spreadsheet-quoting-problems/): How Excel and Google Sheets quoting fails for WhatsApp-first SA sellers — and what a phone catalog-to-quote loop fixes.
- [Stock tracking for traders who sell from a phone](https://vlyt.app/blog/stock-tracking-phone-traders/): Simple stock habits for SA traders and makers who quote and sell from a phone — without a warehouse system.
- [VAT on quotes for small SA businesses](https://vlyt.app/blog/vat-on-quotes-small-business-sa/): How to show VAT on South African quotes in ZAR — inclusive vs exclusive totals, what customers need to see, and what a quote is not.
